name: Galway
housing: Galway's rentals are mostly houses and apartments, with high student demand near the University of Galway.

localRules.text: Landlords in Ireland must register each tenancy with the Residential Tenancies Board within one month of it starting, and every year after.

tenantHelp.name: Residential Tenancies Board (RTB)
tenantHelp.what: state body for tenancy registration and deposit disputes

climate: Galway is one of Ireland's wettest cities, so photograph any damp or mould and check window seals and the heating.
fact: Student demand around the University of Galway makes late summer the busiest time to find a home.
